description: START HERE on this public read-only DS Studio MCP: call with {} or an optional goal (max 500 chars) and languageVersion ('ds2/v2' default or 'ds2/v1'). Returns an official starter .ds2 example, reference metadata, and next read-only lookup steps; actual .ds2 compilation, verification, and PLC conversion run locally in DS Studio (/play) or Local MCP rather than uploading customer code. Use first to orient on docs, examples, and 3D library tools; use dsdx.ping for bare health checks or dsdx.examples.list to browse all starter examples.

goal.description: Optional goal, at most 500 Unicode characters. Hint only; returns an official example.

languageVersion.description: Starter profile: ds2/v2 (default ST expression example) or ds2/v1 (legacy example).

name: dsdx.start
